<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd

# Read input
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv')

# Identify indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year)
indicator_cols = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Compute missingness per indicator
missing_report = []
for col in indicator_cols:
    missing_count = df[col].isna().sum()
    total_count = len(df)
    missing_rate = missing_count / total_count if total_count > 0 else 0.0
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    missing_report.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': int(missing_count),
        'missing_rate': float(missing_rate),
        'kept': kept
    })

missing_report_df = pd.DataFrame(missing_report)
missing_report_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Filter indicators to keep
kept_indicators = [col for col in indicator_cols if missing_report_df.loc[missing_report_df['indicator'] == col, 'kept'].iloc[0]]
selected_cols = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicators
selected_matrix = df[selected_cols]
selected_matrix.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False)
